name: todo-app
description: Full-stack hierarchical todo management app with List and Board views

scripts.dev: npm -w @todo/frontend run dev & npm -w @todo/backend run dev
scripts.build: npm -w @todo/frontend run build && npm -w @todo/backend run build
scripts.lint: npm -w @todo/frontend run lint && npm -w @todo/backend run lint
scripts.test: npm -w @todo/frontend run test && npm -w @todo/backend run test
scripts.type-check: npm -w @todo/frontend run type-check && npm -w @todo/backend run type-check
